payload.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS n, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product) FROM svc_loans) AS nprod, (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT product) FROM svc_loans) AS prods FROM svc_loans l JOIN svc_loan_notes n ON n.loan_id=l.loan_id WHERE LOWER(l.product)='mortgage' AND LOWER(n.note) LIKE '%hardship%'
